headline: Pfizer (PFE) Stock Looks Reasonable Based On Today’s Broader Checks
summary: Pfizer stock has declined 27.7% over the past 5 years, yet the current valuation checks and market multiples now point to a picture that looks closer to fair than clearly cheap or expensive. The 5-year return of 27.7% in the red means long-term shareholders are still under water, which can make today’s pricing feel more attractive than it may actually be on fundamentals. Recent positive trial results for LITFULO in nonsegmental vitiligo and regulatory progress for vaccines and oncology...
